[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | render = [[File:Dryder Husk.jpg|100px]] }} The [[Behemoth Hide]] is the hide claimed from a [[Behemoth]] in [[Vabbi]]. Some collectors will be willing to trade these for an item of choice. ==Acquisition== *[[Nightfall]] **[[Vabbi]] ***[[Behemoth Gravebane]] ***[[Scytheclaw Behemoth]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Behemoth Hide#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Wilderness of Bahdza]]==== [[File:Behemoth-Farm-1.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Behemoth Hides in [[Wilderness of Bahdza]].]] Starting from [[Dzagonur Bastion]], head south to find a handful of small Behemoth groups (if [[Destroy the Harpies]] is active, the southernmost of the 3 marked groups is moved to the [[Resurrection Shrine]] just east of the [[Dzagonur Bastion (outpost)|Dzagonur Bastion]] outpost). Additional groups can be found scattered throughout the area. ====[[Vehjin Mines]]==== [[File:Behemoth-Farm-2.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Behemoth Hides in [[Vehjin Mines]].]] Start from [[Jennur's Horde]] and head north to find an area that is very densely populated with Behemoths. Take note of [[Marobeh Sharptail]], a Dervish boss that can be found along the path. ==Collectors== {{:Awadur/Collector}} {{:Bahlbahs/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|10th August 2009 and 19th November 2012|Wilderness of Bahdza|2 [[Behemoth Hide]]s}} ==Trivia== * Behemoth Hides can be used to make backpacks, according to Nicholas the Traveler.
